title: Data Ingestion Engineer (ADF+Dbt+Snowflake)
description:
**Company Description**
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated
**Data Ingestion Engineer**
to join our data platform team. This role involves building and maintaining scalable, reliable, and secure data pipelines that power analytics, reporting, and decision-making across the organization.
  
  
You will work with
**Snowflake, SQL, dbt, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Python, and PostgreSQL**
o integrate and transform data from a variety of cloud and on-premises sources.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain Snowflake-native data ingestion pipelines using Snowpipe, Snowpipe Streaming, Snow Tasks, and Snow Streams.
* Build automated, scalable ingestion processes to load batch and near-real-time data into Snowflake.
* Design and implement ELT workflows using Snowflake and dbt.
* Integrate Azure Data Factory (ADF) with Snowflake for data movement and orchestration where appropriate.
* Develop Python scripts and utilities for data ingestion, validation, automation, and integration.
* Ingest data from APIs, databases, files, cloud storage, and other internal and external systems into Snowflake.
* Monitor and optimize performance of pipelines and troubleshoot ingestion issues
* Implement data quality checks, logging, alerting, and governance processes
* Maintain technical documentation of data pipelines and workflows.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 4+ years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, or data integration
* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake data warehousing and data ingestion.
* Hands-on experience with Snowpipe and/or Snowpipe Streaming.
* Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for orchestration and pipeline automation
* Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and data manipulation
* Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and working with large data volumes.
* Experience with dbt, preferably with Snowflake.
* Solid working knowledge of Snowflake and PostgreSQL
* Experience using dbt for SQL-based transformation, version control, and documentation
* Strong SQL skills and familiarity with data modeling concepts (e.g., star/snowflake schemas)
* Familiarity with Git and version-controlled development environments

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with API integration and handling large data files (CSV, JSON, XML)
* Familiarity with Azure Blob Storage, Azure Data Lake, or similar
* Exposure to cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
* Understanding of data governance, lineage, and cataloging tools

**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
  
  
From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.
  
  
Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

title: Enterprise Application Technical Lead
description:

**Job Description**
About bp/team
  
  
bp technology is the central organization for all software and platform development. We build all the technology that powers bp’s businesses, from upstream energy production to downstream energy delivery to our customers. We have a variety of teams depending on your areas of interest, including infrastructure and backend services through to customer-facing web and native applications. We encourage our teams to adapt quickly by using native AWS and Azure services, including serverless, and enable them to pick the best technology for a given problem. This is meant to empower our software and platform engineers while allowing them to learn and develop themselves.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Enterprise Application Technical Lead with minimum 10 years of shown experience and at least 3 years in a technical lead capacity. The candidate should have broader development experience in programming languages (e.g. Java/.NET/Spring Boot), Integrations, AWS, and AI engineering to design, build, integrate, and support enterprise-grade digital business solutions.
  
  
The role requires deep expertise in custom application engineering, distributed systems, REST APIs, event-driven integration, enterprise messaging, data architecture, data security and production operations. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, with an expectation to personally contribute to solution design, development, integration engineering, code reviews, production support, and technical delivery.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the technical design, development, implementation, and operational support of complex enterprise applications, including Java/.NET framework services, Spring Boot microservices, MVC-based web components, REST APIs, event-driven integrations, and cloud databases
* Translate business requirements into enterprise solution designs, producing HLD/LLD artefacts, sequence diagrams, data-flow diagrams, and API contracts
* See opportunities and build digital solutions demonstrating AI/ML, LLMs, RAG, Prompt engineering, and Agentic workflows
* Compose and implement REST APIs and event-driven integrations using ActiveMQ (or a similar messaging platform) between enterprise applications and downstream/upstream systems
* Deploy and manage applications using Kubernetes, and cloud-native workloads on AWS, using services such as EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and IAM.
* Ensure data quality, integrity, and security across all enterprise applications, adhering to protocols and organizational guidelines
* Ensure data protection controls, encryption at rest & transit, data masking, PII/sensitive-data handling aligned to relevant compliance standards
* Collaborate with business customers, and external vendors to gather and analyse requirements, and translate them into technical requirements and solution design
* Mentor and guide junior and mid-level developers on technical challenges and troubleshooting issues
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Apply commercial skill to understand business needs and deliver solutions that provide tangible value and align with strategic objectives
* Contribute to the overall data strategy and governance initiatives within the organization

**Job Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* Broader development experience in one or more programming languages (e.g. Java, .NET, Python, C/C++)
* Proven experience leading the design and development of cloud-hosted enterprise-grade solutions
* Solid understanding of enterprise integration, API-led connectivity, and event-driven architecture
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, and observability tooling e.g. Prometheus, Grafana
* Hands-on experience with Claude Code or similar, AI-assisted software engineering practices, and AI-powered development workflows
* Development experience with AI/ML applications would be preferred
* Proven experience in agile scrum delivery
* Proven track record to contribute effectively in group problem-solving environments.
* Experience in establishing and maintaining data strategy and governance frameworks.

Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner!

title: MYSQL Database Administration
description:
**Job Title: Database Administrator (L2)**

**Shift:: Rotational**

**Mode of Work ::**
Work from Office(Monday to Friday)

**Location**
: Hinjewadi, Pune.

**Job Summary**
:

We are looking for a skilled
**Database Administrator (L2)**
with 5 to 9 years of hands-on experience in supporting and managing databases such as MySQL, Secondary skill (MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Oracle). The role involves database administration, performance optimization, backup, and recovery management, and ensuring high availability across various environments like Development, QA, UAT, and Production.

**Key Responsibilities**
:

* Working as a DBA Technical lead to deliver day to day DBA support activities.
* Architecting Infrastructure and databases as per application needs.
* Design MySQL HA and DR solutions.
* Doing POCs on new MySQL products to understand their functionalities.
* Reviewing and selecting latest MySQL versions for new builds/upgrades.
* Work on new MySQL builds with monitoring and backup configurations.
* Work on database deployment planning.
* Work on MySQL version upgrade planning and execution without database downtime.
* Automating repeatable tasks to avoid manual work.
* Handling P1/P2 tickets whenever is required.
* Troubleshoot performance issues.
* Work with Vendor (Oracle) support to get the required patches to fix the bugs which are encountered in the environment.
* Working as an on call DBA in 24\*7 format.
* Design and implement AWS database solutions for MySQL.
* **End-to-End Database Administration**
* Install, configure, and perform version upgrades of databases.
* Manage user accounts and permissions.
* Collaborate with senior teams on schema design and optimization.
* Set up and maintain environments across Dev, QA, UAT, and Production.
* **Performance Optimization**
* Assist in query tuning and create indexing strategies to improve database performance.
* Perform resource utilization analysis (CPU, memory, I/O) to identify and mitigate performance bottlenecks.
* Conduct database structure and normalization reviews to ensure optimal performance.
* Participate in proactive performance audits and implement recommendations.
* **Monitoring & Alerting**
* Monitor real-time database health and performance metrics.
* Set up custom dashboards and alert thresholds for critical databases.
* Monitor database replication and replication lag, escalating issues when necessary.
* Integrate database monitoring with enterprise tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Nagios.
* **Backup & Recovery**
* Support scheduled database backups and configure point-in-time recovery.
* Manage offsite/cloud backup storage and ensure regular restore tests for disaster recovery readiness.
* Troubleshoot backup failures and recovery issues.
* **High Availability (HA) & Failover Support**
* Assist in configuring MySQL replication, Group Replication, or InnoDB Cluster.
* Support MongoDB Replica Sets and Sharding for high availability.
* Contribute to failover strategy planning and execution.
* Assist in performing zero-downtime maintenance for critical systems.
* **Ongoing Maintenance & Support**
* Provide 24x7 incident response and troubleshoot database-related issues in production environments.
* Apply regular patching and security updates to maintain database health.
* Assist in capacity planning and growth analysis to ensure systems can scale as required.
* Contribute to the documentation of processes, SOPs, and knowledge transfer sessions for team members.
* **Collaboration and Team Support**
* Work closely with senior database architects and other teams to ensure smooth system operations.
* Help troubleshoot incidents and provide support for application/database issues.
* Support the development and execution of disaster recovery drills.

**Required Skills & Experience**
:

* 5 to 10 years of experience in database administration with a focus on MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Oracle databases.
* Hands-on experience with database backups, performance tuning, query optimization, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of high availability (HA) setups for databases and systems.
* Good understanding of security best practices for database environments.
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

**Preferred Skills**
:

* Experience with database management tools (e.g., Percona Monitoring and Management (PMM)).
* Experience with MongoDB Ops Manager and database replication strategies.
* Certifications in database management or related technologies are a plus.

**Educational Qualification**
:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Lead Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
**Lead Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Oracle RAC**
**Self-Managed Oracle RAC | HA/DR | Performance | Automation | Engineering Influence**
**Level**
Lead DBRE
  
  
**Domain**
Oracle RAC and Mission-Critical Relational Infrastructure
  
  
**Primary Focus**
Hands-on Oracle RAC reliability, lifecycle ownership, technical escalation, automation, application partnership, and cross-functional execution
  
  
**Work Expectations**
U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required
  
  

* Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Lead DBRE with deep hands-on expertise in Oracle Database and self-managed Oracle RAC environments. The role owns technical execution for a major Oracle domain and improves reliability, performance, scalability, lifecycle management, automation, and operational discipline.
  
  
Beyond traditional DBA operations, the Lead DBRE partners with application and infrastructure teams to influence schema, SQL, connection management, resiliency, observability, and safe deployment practices. The role remains hands-on while providing technical leadership, mentoring, and incident escalation.
  
  

* Level Scope and Leadership Expectations

Lead DBRE is a senior technical leadership role focused on owning execution for a major database domain. The expectation is to solve difficult production problems, lead initiatives end to end, guide engineers, create durable operating standards, and drive cross-functional closure without default people-management responsibility.
  
  
**Dimension**
**Expectation at This Level**
**Scope of Ownership**
Owns reliability and execution for a significant Oracle platform domain, including incidents, lifecycle activities, routine maintenance, capacity risks, HA/DR readiness, and service-impacting improvements.
  
  
**Technical Depth**
Diagnoses complex RAC, Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, SQL performance, storage, interconnect, OS, backup, and recovery problems.
  
  
**Technical Leadership**
Acts as a primary escalation point, mentors engineers, reviews designs, raises standards, and influences application and infrastructure decisions.
  
  
**Execution**
Leads complex initiatives end to end, aligns stakeholders, manages dependencies, and drives permanent corrective actions to closure.
  
  
**Communication**
Explains technical tradeoffs, communicates clearly during incidents, and keeps risks, ownership, dependencies, and timelines visible.
  
  
**Automation and Standards**
Builds repeatable automation, CI/CD practices, runbooks, monitoring, and golden paths that reduce toil and failure risk.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Oracle RAC Platform Ownership
* Administer and improve Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, Clusterware, ASM, services, SCAN/listeners, and interconnect configurations.
* Plan and execute patching, upgrades, migrations, capacity changes, and lifecycle activities with controlled change and rollback practices.
* Design, operate, and validate Data Guard, RMAN, backup/recovery, failover, switchover, and disaster-recovery procedures.
* Performance and Incident Leadership
* Lead performance analysis using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, execution plans, SQL Trace, TKPROF, and OS/storage diagnostics.
* Diagnose Cache Fusion, GC waits, workload placement, connection storms, cluster instability, storage latency, and interconnect issues.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for critical incidents, lead stabilization and RCA, and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Engineering Influence and Shift-Left Reliability
* Partner with application teams on SQL, indexing, partitioning, schema design, bind usage, connection pooling, transaction boundaries, and resilient failover behavior.
* Establish database design reviews, deployment guardrails, developer guidance, and production-readiness standards.
* Automation and Observability
* Automate provisioning, validation, patching, maintenance, backup checks, DR exercises, health checks, and recurring remediation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
* Improve Oracle observability using OEM, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or comparable tools; define actionable service indicators and objectives.
* Required Qualifications and Experience
* 8+ years of database or reliability engineering experience, including significant Lead or Senior responsibility for self-managed production Oracle RAC.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure/Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, RAC Services, SCAN/listeners, Cache Fusion, and interconnect behavior.
* Strong Oracle performance tuning and diagnostics experience using AWR, ASH, execution plans, SQL Trace, and Linux diagnostics.
* Experience with patching, upgrades, migrations, backup/recovery, DR exercises, and controlled production change.
* Strong Linux/Unix systems troubleshooting skills.
* Hands-on automation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or comparable tooling.
* Strong technical leadership, mentoring, incident communication, and cross-functional execution skills.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Oracle Exadata, OCI, Cloud@Customer, AWS, or hybrid Oracle deployment experience.
* Application Continuity, FAN, TAF, FSFO, Far Sync, GoldenGate, GDS, TDE, ZDLRA, or advanced Oracle HA capabilities.
* Database schema CI/CD using Liquibase, Flyway, Bytebase, or comparable tooling.
* Oracle certifications or relevant SRE/cloud architecture credentials.
* Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months
* Establish measurable reliability, MTTR, patching, backup/recovery, and DR-readiness baselines and deliver material improvement.
* Automate high-frequency and high-risk operational workflows, prioritizing safety, maintainability, and auditability.
* Establish a practical database architecture and production-readiness review process with measurable adoption by application teams.
* Deliver documented capacity, lifecycle, resiliency, and corrective-action plans for critical RAC environments.
* What This Role Does Not Include
* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is expected through technical direction, mentoring, and execution ownership.
* This is not a project-management-only role; the Lead DBRE must remain deeply hands-on.
* This is not a traditional DBA ticket queue; durable fixes, automation, standards, capacity planning, and reliability improvements are expected.
* This role does not own application code or business logic, although it influences database-impacting application design.
* The role does not assume unlimited or last-minute DBRE capacity; work must be planned, prioritized, communicated, and committed through the appropriate process.
* Work Expectations and Location

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability before go-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source-to-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data.
* Confirm and pressure-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design.
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth.
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery.
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap.

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5+ years of hands-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

You will own implementation quality, make component-level engineering decisions within the agreed architecture, and deliver data that operational applications and analytical solutions can reliably consume.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Extraction and ingestion**

* Configure supported Cognite extractors and implement API or custom integrations where required.
* Build source-appropriate incremental loads with persistent checkpoints, retries and restart behaviour; handle pagination, throttling, historical backfills and late-arriving updates.
* Implement repeatable writes and reconciliation checks so rerunning failed loads does not create inconsistent results.
* Validate source-to-target counts, time ranges and completeness while preserving identifiers, units and quality information.
* Diagnose failures involving connectivity, permissions, source changes and malformed records.

**Data modelling and transformation**

* Implement approved spaces, containers, views, data models, instances and relationships.
* Reuse or extend Core Data Model concepts in line with the solution design.
* Develop SQL transformations and Python processing for cleansing, normalization, mapping and enrichment.
* Implement stable identifiers and source crosswalks, including collision checks for repeated tags across sites.
* Preserve distinctions between equipment, functional locations and changing assignments; test schema changes and execute migrations without breaking dependent consumers.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas data**

* Implement identifier-based matching, rules and supported contextualization services to connect operational and engineering records.
* Link time series, maintenance activities and documents to the correct equipment or functional location.
* Validate matches against reference mappings, assess coverage and false matches, and route unresolved cases for domain review.
* Maintain mappings when tags, equipment assignments, hierarchies or document revisions change.
* Preserve upstream well and wellbore identities, provenance, tests and intervention history; preserve downstream equipment relationships, units, laboratory timing, and links between diagrams, documents and measurements.

**Testing, deployment and application handoff**

* Write and review production Python and SQL code with automated tests.
* Test completeness, freshness, uniqueness, relationship integrity, time-zone handling and recovery after interruption.
* Maintain configuration in Git and automate supported deployment using Cognite Toolkit.
* Monitor extraction, transformation and workflow execution with actionable logs and failure handling; configure least-privilege access.
* Deliver documented consumer views and example SDK/API queries, verify access and performance, maintain runbooks, and identify design changes requiring architecture review.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Substantial hands-on Cognite Data Fusion implementation experience and understanding of production operation.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, including Cognite SDK and REST API usage.
* Experience implementing CDF data models, transformations and contextualization.
* Experience building pipelines with incremental loading, reconciliation, backfill and recovery.
* Practical knowledge of Git, automated testing, CI/CD and deployment configuration.
* Familiarity with authentication and the CDF capabilities required by integration services.
* Strong implementation knowledge in at least one upstream or downstream setting, with ability to apply relevant concepts to the other.
* Evidence of personally delivering and troubleshooting data pipelines used by operational or engineering applications.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Cognite Toolkit, extraction pipeline monitoring and workflow orchestration.
* Familiarity with AVEVA PI, SAP maintenance data, IBM Maximo, laboratory systems or well-data services.
* Experience with WITSML, OPC UA, database extraction or enterprise APIs.
* Experience with document or diagram contextualization and 3D associations.
* Working knowledge of a major cloud platform and containerized integration services.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A technical lead who can demonstrate a functioning ingestion-to-consumption workflow, explain their personal implementation contribution, and show how failed loads, duplicate records, incorrect relationships and application-access issues are detected and corrected.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Act as guardian of data quality, ensuring every record is complete, accurate and validated before go-live.
* Transition post go-live into the permanent Master Data Analyst role, owning ongoing data quality, customer creation and maintenance.

Key Responsibilities — Build Phase (From Now — September 2027)
  
  

* Define data migration scope, including all OUS customer records, credit limits, payment terms, dunning procedures, bank details, contact data and credit history.
* Build the data mapping document from MDT fields to S/4HANA fields.
* Coordinate with the MDT data team for extract and transformation activities.
* Define data quality rules and cleansing requirements.
* Identify and resolve data gaps, duplicates and errors.
* Execute minimum two data migration test cycles.
* Reconcile MDT source data to S/4HANA target with 100% match required.
* Support data cut-over planning and rehearsal.
* Own go-live data readiness and sign-off on data quality.
* Document all data transformation rules and exceptions.

Key Responsibilities — Run Phase (September 2027 onwards)
  
  

* Own customer master data creation and maintenance in S/4HANA.
* Load approved credit limits.
* Maintain payment terms and dunning configuration by customer.
* Monitor and resolve data quality issues.
* Manage duplicate account identification and merge activities.
* Validate customer bank details for refund processing.
* Support audit data requests.
* Maintain data quality KPIs.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of SAP master data experience.
* Customer master data experience, including XD01/XD02 or Business Partner (BP).
* Experience with data migration tools such as LSMW, LTMC or S/4HANA MDG.
* Data quality management and cleansing experience.
* Reconciliation and validation techniques.
* Strong Excel and analytical skills.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* S/4HANA data migration experience.
* AR-specific master data experience, including credit limits, payment terms and dunning procedures.
* Healthcare or medical devices industry experience.
* Experience migrating between SAP systems.
* SQL or data extraction tool experience.
* Understanding of GDPR and data protection.

**Physical Job Requirements**
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
  
  
**Benefits & Compensation**
**MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package**
At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.
  
  
**About MiniMed**
We want to make every day a better day for people living with diabetes. Our team of creative innovators around the globe share a passion for finding the simplest solutions to the problems that people with diabetes face on a daily basis. For more than 40 years, we've been redefining what's possible, from intelligent dosing systems designed for real life to predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and we're dedicated to continuing to support our customers through every step of their journey — meeting them where and how they need it.

title: Support Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**
Our customers are at the forefront of some of the most interesting data in the world, using SingleStore to push the boundaries every day. To do this well, they leverage the expertise of our Support Engineering Team, composed of technical subject matter experts on the frontline of critical customer issues.
  
  
This Support Engineering role skews far more towards engineering than typical technical support as you will need to delve into database internals and memory allocators, investigate Linux and host-related configurations, and diagnose SQL query behaviour, all in the name of resolving complex database issues. Our Support Engineers are constantly learning a wide range of customer systems and technical concepts and are thrilled by the new and exciting challenges that they encounter on a regular basis.
  
  
To accurately identify the source and solution of an issue, this team will take the time to learn about the customer’s business and systems while helping to improve their fundamental SingleStore and database operational knowledge. This often requires additional research and time spent on learning new technologies and tools outside of SingleStore while also being deeply engaged with multiple departments including development teams, query performance engineering, product management, infrastructure SREs, etc.
  
  
**Required Hours**

* The hours required are from 11:30 AM IST - 8:30 PM IST (9 hours) for 5 days
* Participate in our on-call rotation that may include weekends and holidays.

**Role And Responsibilities**

* Provide email and live technical support to our enterprise customers, acting as the first line of defense for complex technical issues, bug diagnosis, or resolving critical outages.
* Identify and reproduce product issues, perform QA, and submit formal bug reports or feature requests to the appropriate Engineering team.
* Collaborate closely with software developers, sales engineers, and technical account managers to keep all teams up to date with current issues a customer may be facing.
* Work to streamline and improve various Support and Engineering processes and tools, author new internal run-books or public documentation, and help the team continually improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Ensure customers have a positive support experience during every interaction.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 4+ years of advanced customer-facing technical support experience.
* Experience with MySQL or MySQL-like (MariaDB, Aurora, etc) database and SQL Query Optimization.
* A solid Kubernetes and sysadmin skill set. Also, comfortable testing software and finding its limits, hands-on with Linux, checking utilization of system I/O, measuring network throughput, and are comfortable navigating large log files.
* Experience with a scripting or coding language. Whether it’s Python, Bash, or Go, you should have a go-to solution for quick and dirty problem-solving and be able to navigate through our code base.
* Familiarity with distributed systems and AWS/GCP. You understand how organizations deploy and maintain distributed applications and services across multiple machines Bonus points for knowing how to analyze them for performance bottlenecks and remove single points of failure.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Have the ability to explain technical concepts to a wide range of end-users.

SingleStore delivers the cloud-native database with the speed and scale to power the world’s data-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv.
  
  
Consistent with our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people.
  
  
*To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.*
SingleStore values individuals for their unique skills and experiences, and we’re proud to offer roles in a variety of locations across the United States. Salary is based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location, and is just one part of our total compensation and benefits package. Certain roles are also eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases and annual bonuses.
  
  
*For candidates residing in California, please see our*
*California Recruitment Privacy Notice*
*. For candidates residing in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, please see our*
*EEA, UK, and Swiss Recruitment Privacy Notice.*

title: Application Development & Support Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Position Overview
  
  
The Data Quality Developer will play a hands-on technical role in implementing and maintaining data quality controls, monitoring frameworks, and integration solutions across our enterprise MDM ecosystem. This position requires a strong technical background combined with excellent communication skills to work effectively with business stakeholders across the globe.
  
  
Working closely with the Data Governance Council Lead, this role will be responsible for configuring data quality platforms, implementing validation rules and workflows, developing dashboards and reports, and remediating data quality incidents across customer, supplier, contact, and item domains.
  
  
Two Data Quality Developers will be hired — one focused primarily on the Ataccama platform (configuration, rules, profiling, monitoring) and the other focused on data quality operations outside of Ataccama (cross-system reconciliation, integrations, dashboards, remediation). Both developers serve as each other's backup and are expected to be cross-trained across all responsibilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities Data Quality Platform Configuration & Customization
  
  

* Configure and customize data quality platforms (primarily Ataccama) to ensure optimal user experience for data management
* Implement data quality rules, validation logic, and automated controls within the DQ platform
* Develop and maintain workflows to manage reference data across systems
* Build monitoring capabilities for operational processes and data quality metrics
* Perform data profiling and analysis using platform-native tools to identify data quality issues and patterns
* Configure DQ platform integrations with MDM, Snowflake, and enterprise source systems

Data Quality Analysis & Remediation
  
  

* Run reports across systems to calculate data quality dimensions (completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness)

title: Senior System Administrator - Windchill
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.
  
  
Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.
  
  
The Senior System Administrator is responsible for defining, administering, and maintaining the hardware, software, and environments for PLM, Regulatory, R&D and Clinical systems required to support Edwards’ business transformation from development through production. This role collaborates with Architects and Application Owners to create and manage system environments, supports administration and maintenance, defines release management, source code control, build and deployment procedures, and ensures environments are available, secure, compliant, and performing as expected. The role works closely with cross-functional IT, Infrastructure, Compliance, Configuration, Development, vendor, and business teams to maintain system availability, support upgrades, execute deployments, manage backups and disaster recovery planning, and maintain infrastructure-related validation documentation.
  
  
**How will you make an impact:**

* Administer, install, update, optimize, debug, and maintain PTC Windchill applications and related system environments across development, test, certification, and production.
* Lead and Manage application administration activities across the lifecycle, including vendor coordination, installation, data import, upgrades, user issue resolution, permissions and roles, backups, automation, and application retirement.
* Define, maintain, and execute source code management, release management, deployment, and configuration management work instructions to support Configuration and Development teams.
* Build releases, including weekly, on-demand, and snapshot releases for local instances, and support code deployments, configuration changes, code review, and test coordination.
* Plan, configure, document, and support high availability, backup, security, SSL certificate, HTTPS, LDAPS, disaster recovery, and environment readiness requirements.
* Provide guidance on non-functional requirements, including performance, load testing, benchmarking, scalability, resilience, and operational readiness.
* Perform Windchill system maintenance activities, including upgrades, patches, security vulnerability remediation, new release installation, daily and weekly maintenance plans, WinDU, WinRU, revaulting, and environment refresh or rehosting.
* Maintain Windchill vault space, administer CAD and Office workers, perform log and temporary file cleanup and rotation, and support remote file server setup and maintenance.
* Review Server Manager, Method Server, and other Windchill logs for issues; administer, monitor, and report through PTC System Monitor.
* Write and maintain deployment scripts, coordinate environment resources and schedules, monitor CPU, RAM, and disk space growth, and plan for expansion or cleanup as needed.
* Lead and Perform issue resolution, root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement to strengthen system stability and reduce recurring issues.
* Support coordinated patching, hotfix, and vulnerability remediation activities for Oracle RDC/Clinical and SAS Analytics platforms across OS, application, and database layers, partnering with IT Database and Infrastructure teams to strengthen compliance, stability, and risk mitigation.
* Author and maintain system administration, infrastructure, validation, work instruction, deployment, and environment maintenance documentation to support compliance and audit readiness.
* Provide on-call critical support and partner with Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts, application users, vendors, and cross-functional teams to resolve issues and maintain service levels.
* Lead and mentor junior/new team members by providing technical guidance, ensuring adherence to support processes, and driving the creation and maintenance of high-quality technical documentation, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

**What you'll need (Required):**

* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related IT discipline.
* 5–7 years of related working experience in PTC Windchill v12.0.1 or above system administration.
* 5–7 years of IT experience demonstrating solid performance while working with cross-functional IT and business teams on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.
* Hands-on experience administering Windchill environments across development, test, certification, and production, including installation, upgrades, patching, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
* Experience with Windchill maintenance and administration activities such as WinDU, WinRU, revaulting, vault space management, CAD and Office worker administration, remote file server maintenance, and log review.
* Experience supporting source code management, release management, build and deployment procedures, deployment scripting, environment refreshes, and configuration changes.
* Experience supporting high availability, backup, security, SSL certificate, HTTPS, LDAPS, disaster recovery, performance, load testing, and system monitoring requirements.
* Experience supporting Oracle RDC/Clinical and SAS Analytics platform patching or hotfix activities across OS, application, and database layers, including coordination with IT Database and Infrastructure teams on implementation, vulnerability remediation, compliance, stability, and risk mitigation efforts.
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, analytical, detail-oriented, organizational, and information-seeking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal relationship skills, and ability to interact professionally with all organizational levels.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Experience working in multi-workstream development environments using DevOps CI/CD tools and methodologies, with working knowledge of JIRA and GitLab.
* Experience in Codebeamer administration, configuration, workflow management, or integration with enterprise engineering and ALM processes.
* Technical skills in Java, JSP, JavaScript, XML, JSON, SQL, PL/SQL, SOAP, RESTful Web Services, Python, and relevant code development languages and concepts.
* Experience with enterprise application and platform administration across Windows Server, IIS Web Server, Apache Tomcat, RHEL/Linux administration, Microsoft .NET, SSL certificate management, load balancers, routing, firewall concepts, access control, networking, and communication protocols.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SQL queries, Oracle APEX administration, Oracle DB 19c, SOLR or search engine indexing concepts, Aras PLM, SAS Administration, AWS servers, and patch management.
* Experience in medical device, pharmaceutical, highly regulated, or corporate enterprise environments.
* Excellent organization and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and work toward long-term goals.
* Strong relationship management, negotiation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive achievement of objectives across teams.
* Substantial knowledge and understanding of computer science fundamentals.
* Strict attention to detail and ability to work independently in a complex enterprise support environment.

Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.

You'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match \& merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes — ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use.

* Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles.
* Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports.
* Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects.

* Hands\-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts — entities, relationships, match \& merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows — sufficient to design meaningful test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases.
* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools.
* Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
* Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy).
* Experience with data quality testing concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint\-based delivery teams.


****Preferred Qualifications****

* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines.

 Generalist architect assigned to an IT portfolio (Logistics tech, Sales tech, Ecom etc,.) for creating solution designs for new capabilities/projects that the Portfolio implements and for leading/trouble shooting and supporting operational initiatives within the portfolio like technical upgrades of systems, patches, support for outages etc.

 MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES
   

  

 Leads evaluation, design, and analysis for the implementation of a solutions architecture with the assigned Portfolio across a group of specific business applications or technologies based on enterprise business strategy, business capabilities, value\-streams, business requirements and enterprise standards.
   

  

 Collaborates with management, business leaders, and other stakeholders in the assigned Portfolio and Enterprise architecture, to connect the business roadmap with operational decisions.
   

  

 Identifies the organizational impact (for example, on skills, processes, structures or culture) and financial impact of the solutions architecture.
   

  

 Translates business and technical requirements into an architectural blueprint to achieve business objectives and documents all architecture design and analysis work.
   

  

 Works closely with the product owners and project/product managers to ensure a robust architectural runway that can support future business requirements throughout the product lifecycle.
   

  

**Minimum Job Requirements**

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information\-technology, systems engineering or a related study
   

  

****Work Experience****
 At least 5 years of experience with multiple IT solution development disciplines, including technical or infrastructure architecture, network management, application development, middleware, database management or cloud development
   

  

****Knowledge / Skills / Abilities****
 Experience delivering presentations to senior\-level executives and technical audiences.
   

  

 Experience with various software development technologies (such as JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Java, .NET, PHP, ABAP)
   

  

 Experience with various database technologies (such as MSSQL, MongoDB, Oracle, HANA)
   

  

 Experience developing system designs, strategies, evaluations, and roadmaps.
   

  

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to effectively communicate with technical and non\-technical staff at all levels of the organization.
   

  

 Solid understanding of product management, agile principles and development methodologies and capability of supporting agile teams by providing advice and guidance on opportunities, impact and risks, taking account of technical and architectural debt
   

  

 Excellent interpersonal skills in areas such as teamwork, facilitation and negotiation.
   

  

 Strong leadership skills.
   

  

 Excellent analytical and technical skills.
   

  

 Excellent planning and organizational skills.
   

  

 Skilled at influencing, guiding and facilitating stakeholders and peers with decision making.
   

  

 Knowledge of various aspects of an enterprise technology architecture like business, information, data, network and security
   

  

 Ability to understand and apply various diagraming and modeling techniques.
   

  

 Good understanding of strategic and emerging technology trends, and the practical application of those technologies to evolving business and operating models.
   

  

 Ability to work effectively in a team environment and lead cross\-functional teams.
   

  

 Strong understanding of the company’s processes, organization, customers, and business models.
   

  

**Preferred Job Requirements**
**Work Experience**
 Experience in working with multi\-site global teams
   

  

 4\+ years of DevSecOps experience –including unit testing, CI/CD, security compliance, functional/performance/stress test automation
   

  

 Experience architecting secure applications for Healthcare and are familiar with PHI, PII, and HIPAA compliance requirements
   

  

****Knowledge / Skills / Abilities****

 Understanding and knowledge of an Agile system development life cycle methodology (such as Scrum at Scale, SAFe, Kanban, etc.)

description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:** 
 Planisware Architect
   

  

**Location: Pune, India**
**Company Overview**
**About SLB**
 SLB is the world's leading provider of technology for reservoir characterization, drilling, production, and processing to the oil and gas industry. Working in more than 85 countries and employing approximately 100,000 people who represent over 140 nationalities, SLB supplies the industry's most comprehensive range of products and services, from exploration through production and integrated pore\-to\-pipeline solutions for hydrocarbon recovery that optimize reservoir performance. Visit www.slb.com for more information.
   

  

 We are a global technology company driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. Our inclusive culture is the key to our success. We collaborate with our internal community of colleagues, alumni, and our valued external partners to support each other and achieve our goals. We aim to raise the bar high. We look for people who are committed to innovation and success and act with integrity to become and be a part of one of the most diverse group of experts in our industry, anywhere around the globe. Global in outlook, and local in practice, we're united in our passion for discovering solutions and in our commitment to creating a sustainable and balanced future. We set the bar high. So we’re looking for talented, driven people committed to innovation and success and who act with integrity. We'll give you a platform to develop both professionally and personally, supported by our community of colleagues, co\-workers, alumni, and our valued external partners. It's a deep collaboration that enables us all to achieve our goals. Come and be part of one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive groups of industry experts.
   

  

**About SLB India Technology Center**
 SLB has embarked on a corporate transformation to deliver a step change in the reliability, efficiency and integration of our technologies, products and services. Advanced technologies are key enablers to this and encompass all aspects of business systems, including the organization platform and processes. Investments in, and building strong competences across our technology pillars – IT Central, SAP, Cyber Security, Digital Enterprise Systems, Data and Analytics, Digital Operations, Architecture and Integration, and Governance and Performance are key to an integrated digital that is positioned to deliver superior results. The SLB India Technology Center has a fundamental and critical role in this corporate transformation and for delivering digital solutions to the larger SLB organization.
   

  

**About Role**
 Slb has an opening in Coimbatore / Pune, India and Bogota, Columbia for a Technical Lead who will work on the Development / configuration for all modules / capabilities, changes and bug fixes related to Planisware and Microsoft .Net suite of applications in the Product and Service Delivery Function under Enterprise Solutions.
   

  

 The end users supported are the global community in Slb using these systems. Both L1 support and L2 support is provided in\-house while L3 Development and Support is outsourced to vendors.
   

  

 This role will work closely with the Scrum team on defining / change requirements and align with the development team (L3, vendors) for technical design and effort validation. Further, he/she will define periodic release plans and release schedules in coordination with the domain teams and the L3 vendor while being supervised by the Chief Scrum Master. He / she would manage the execution of release activities and co\-ordinate with the L3 development teams to ensure releases are delivered on time and within budget.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

 Technical Responsibilities
   

  

* Solution Design \& Architecture: Lead the design and architecture of standard as well as customized Planisware solution to address Project Management needs/Stakeholders
* Strategic Alignment: Work with product management and IT leadership to align Planisware functionality with business strategies and project goals.
* Obtain business requirements and use cases / user stories from Product and Service Delivery, Supply, Distribution and Operation Planning Domains for all enhancements. Validate all such requirements and articulate to the L3 teams
* Customization Framework: Define best practices and frameworks for customizing Planisware to meet the evolving needs of the business.
* Integration Strategy: Develop and implement integration strategies to connect Planisware with other enterprise systems. Optimizing the API calls to minimize the performance issues \& Cost.
* Governance \& Best Practices: Establish governance around Planisware usage, ensuring the platform is optimized for scalability, security, and performance.
* Performance Tuning: Monitor system performance, ensuring efficient use of resources, and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
* Technical Leadership: Provide guidance and mentorship to development teams, ensuring high\-quality deliverables Serve as a SPOC to the L3 inhouse / vendor development team and coordinate all development and testing activities. Help development team to understand the error causes on production environment
* Review and get technical feasibility validation of the technical design provided by L3 for the change requests.
* Ensure adoption of Scrum in the development process. Also ensure DevOps is adopted within the team efficiently
* Work on roll\-back scenarios and identify cases where roll\-backs are necessary


 Release Management
   

  

* Assist the Technical Team in the design and development of the release management process
* Expertise in various PLW modules, including Oscar and PMGo modules.
* Proven experience in designing and deploying Planisware for large\-scale organizations, particularly in product or project management. Familiarity with enterprise architecture and software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies
* Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
* Ensure technical documentation is kept up to date by the development team
* Proactively identify and implement procedures to streamline the build process which may drive the development and maintenance of an automated build process
* Periodically reports performance metric dashboard for releases handled. Communicate release details and schedules to the Domains as required


**Essential Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field
* 10\+ years of overall support/development experience, of which 5 \+ years on Planisware.
* Planisware Certification – Specialist OR Expert
* 4\+ years in Change and Release Management
* 3 to 4 years of experience building on Web apps / Desktop Apps using technologies like React, Angular, Java ASP.NET, etc.
* Good understanding of consuming APIs through Single Page Application (SPA).
* Good exposure to database technologies like Oracle, MS SQL Server, etc.


**Key competencies**
* In\-depth knowledge of the change management process working on the change and release module
* Should have a thorough understanding and working knowledge of ITIL processes including Application Change and Release Management
* Experience working on multiple releases/projects as a subject matter expert and as a technical leader. Should have worked on complex projects that require expertise across multiple disciples and environments
* Very good understanding around building Planisware based solution and Integration / data migration processes
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum/Kanban environment
* Good knowledge of Azure IaaS / PaaS
* Very good experience of version management.
* Experience of providing overall process improvements adopting to the release process
* Advanced knowledge of Software Development Lifecycle
* Preferred experience in Oil \& Gas industry (though not mandatory)


**Other Skills And Abilities**
* Self\-driven, Proactive, Systems Thinking
* Open to travel abroad and in India
* Comfortable working occasional extended hours demanded by emergency release
* Exposure to Performance Tuning (Tuning concepts \- indexes, segments, partitions, query tuning) of database systems would be an added advantage
* Works well with all personality types


**SLB as an employer**
 As a leading employer in our industry, SLB is proud to offer a highly competitive package of base and incentive compensation as well as a comprehensive benefits program designed to support the health, wellness and financial security of our employees and their families. SLB is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or other characteristics protected by law.

* Advanced knowledge and experience with SAP S4 HANA TRM Module.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills, coupled with a strong interest in further developing and integrating enterprise domain knowledge with technology skills.

* Must have at least 2 end\-to\-end implementation experience and strong hands\-on experience in SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) module.
* Proficiency in S/4HANA Finance with a focus on Treasury, Cash, and Liquidity Management
* Experience in Cash Management, Bank Communication Management (BCM), and In\-House Cash (IHC)
* Good understanding of Credit Risk, financial instruments, and exposure management.
* Familiarity and Hands on experience with SAP FICO concepts, including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting.
* Knowledge of integration with FI, CO, MM, and external banking systems.
* Candidate should be capable to understand the existing Legacy as\-is application \& business set up and implement in SAP all the sub\-modules of SAP treasury.
* Should participate in BPP workshops, design \& implement solutions in SAP.
* Should provide architectural suggestions on set up and integration between existing SAP \& non\-SAP systems.
* Should be able to lead a team of functional \& technical consultants.
* Should be able to draw up proposals \& plans for the project.
